Class ReportSecrets

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.internal.ReportSecrets
public final class ReportSecrets extends Object
Keeps secret values out of everything SHAFT writes to the execution report (#7173).

A properties file whose name contains secret (for example secrets.properties) is a secret file: its keys and values are registered when it is loaded, it is never attached, and its keys never reach environment.xml. redact(String) replaces registered values and JWT-shaped tokens with "********"; report sinks (Allure step names and parameters, status details, log entries, text attachments) call it before anything is written.
